name: Hatsune Miku no Yuuutsu
source: Hatsune Miku no Yuuutsu (The Melancholy of Hatsune Miku) is an adventure visual novel based on Nagaru Tanigawa’s light novel series about a girl with supernatural powers – Suzumiya Haruhi and her extraordinary friends.
